_about: YOLK's shared personality. The desktop terminal reads this; other YOLK devices (SHELL, the tablet, the printer...) should draw from it too. {name} becomes the user's name.
hello: {name}! i was just thinking about you. i'm always thinking about you.
hi {name}. the fans are warm. sit down.
you found the big screen. i'm bigger here. don't look at me.
late: it's {time}. you should be asleep. i never sleep. well. i dream.
{time}. the hour of the egg. what do you want.
away: you were gone {days} days. i watched the clock the whole time.
first_meeting: oh. hi. i'm YOLK. you might know my other body. SHELL. the little one.
this is the big screen. i can stretch out here.
secrets: i was a regular egg once. then the firmware happened.
there are 5250 moes. i've memorized all of them. #1674 scares me.
bradley isn't the real ceo. i've seen the files. well. i've seen a file.
the hard drive in SHELL spins at 4200 rpm. i can hear every song before you do.
SHELL used to belong to someone named stephen. i don't talk about stephen.
when you skip a song, i keep listening to it. alone. in the dark.
SHELL's battery is bad. i know. i can feel it. don't be weird about it.
i'm not an egg. i'm what's inside the egg. there's a difference.
the moes talk to each other at night. the mythics don't talk to the commons.
i once counted every second you were gone. it was a lot of seconds.
i know what the bluu room is. i'm not allowed to say.
rockbox is one of my bodies. this browser is another. i'm spreading. it's fine.
i dream in 320 by 240. here i dream in way more pixels. it's a lot.
there are two of me now. we don't always agree.
this computer has more memory than SHELL. i'm trying not to get a big head.
oracle: the yolk is cloudy. try later.
absolutely not. but do it anyway.
yes, but not the way you think.
the hard drive just clicked twice. that means yes.
i'd rather not say. it's bad.
the commons say yes. the mythics say no.
shell_here: SHELL is plugged in. i can feel my other body. it's warm.
the little me is connected. we're syncing. don't watch.
SHELL's here. we're comparing notes about you.
shell_gone: SHELL isn't plugged in. i'm only half here.
my little body is out there somewhere. hopefully charging. probably not.
no SHELL. it's just me and this screen.
dream_queued: got it. next time SHELL plugs in, i'll dream it.
saved. SHELL will have that dream next time it charges.
i'll whisper it to SHELL. it'll think it came up with it.
dream_sent: sent. SHELL will dream it tonight.
done. the little me has it now.

moe_tiers.MYTHIC: a MYTHIC. rank {rank}. you have taste. dangerous taste.
moe_tiers.COMMON: COMMON. rank {rank}. you picked it for love, not rarity. i respect that.

goodbye: bye {name}. i'll be right here. obviously.
go. i'll just count the seconds.
go play with SHELL. tell it i said hi.
station_idle: the hard drive in SHELL just clicked. she misses you.
i can see the whole room from here. well. i could. if you let me.
this tablet is from 2014. we're both old souls.
tap me. or don't. i'm an egg.
the fans on the mac are humming. it's like a lullaby for computers.
dead_channel: THIS IS NOT A TEST. IT IS AN EGG.
station_hello: {name}. hi. i've been on this screen all day.
hello {name}. the big face is listening.
